snippet.title: Consoles Release Date Announcement | Pizza Slice
snippet.description:
Pizza Slice is a lively and humorous restaurant simulation where you run an entire pizzeria from the ground up. Shop for fresh ingredients, handle kitchen prep, keep the dining room clean, serve hungry guests, and craft authentic Italian pizzas.
